fieldNotes.location: Roster coordinates (39.461246,-75.036652, ROOFTOP) correctly landed on the large industrial plant at 500 W Elmer Rd, Vineland NJ. Locked center 39.4610,-75.0365.
fieldNotes.ownership: OWNERSHIP CHANGE - this is the former General Mills Progresso soup plant (built 1970, 580,000 sq ft, 65 acres). General Mills closed the plant in 2017/2018 and sold it for ~$4.5M to F&S Produce Co. (now F&S Fresh Foods), which retrofitted it for fresh-cut produce, salsas, IQF fruits/vegetables and purees. The roster's General Mills attribution (from the Hyster GM plant list) is stale - the physical freight facility is audited as it stands today.
fieldNotes.truckGate: The truck yard (W-side dock face and N drop yard) is enclosed by a continuous chain-link perimeter fence, clearly visible in 2026-04 Street View behind the front parking lot. A single main access driveway leaves W Elmer Rd on the SE side; trucks pass through a gate in the yard fence to reach the docks. Treated as a controlled truck entrance.
fieldNotes.guardShack: No staffed guard booth identified at the road or the yard-fence gate in 2026-04 Street View; the entrance driveway is open at the public road. Flagged uncertain.
fieldNotes.remoteGs: Set true - there is a fenced/gated truck yard but no confirmed staffed booth. Low confidence, flagged.
fieldNotes.drivewayLong: The access driveway runs from W Elmer Rd up the SE/E side of the plant before reaching the docks/yard - deep enough to stack 3+ trucks.
fieldNotes.dockDoors: Continuous dock bank along the W wall of the main building with ~25-40 trailers backed in. Banded 25-50.
fieldNotes.dropArea: A row of drop trailers parked along the N side of the building, separate from the active W dock face - roughly 15-25 stalls. Banded 10-25.
fieldNotes.shipRcvSeparate: Dock activity is concentrated on the W building face with the N apron used mainly for trailer storage - treated as a single ship/receive dock cluster.
fieldNotes.urbanRural: Plant sits on the wooded NW fringe of Vineland (a small South Jersey city) surrounded by woods and farmland - per the rubric's small-town-industrial guidance, classified Rural.
fieldNotes.railServed: A rail line curves through the woods EAST of the property but does NOT spur into this parcel - it serves other facilities. Not rail-served.
fieldNotes.siteAreaAcres: Perimeter box ~67 acres, consistent with the reported 65-acre parcel.
fieldNotes.buildingCount: One large interconnected manufacturing building with attached production/office sections; counted as a single building.
fieldNotes.scale: No truck scale identified in imagery - flagged uncertain.
